summary: This is an 8-K filing reporting the issuance of asset-backed notes (Class A-1 through A-4) by Honda Auto Receivables 2026-2 Owner Trust, with American Honda Receivables LLC as depositor and American Honda Finance Corporation as sponsor. The notes were issued on May 13, 2026 pursuant to a final prospectus dated May 5, 2026. The filing includes standard transaction documents (receivables purchase agreement, trust agreement, sale and servicing agreement). AHFC initially retains at least 5% of each note class per risk-retention rules. This is a routine securitization, not a special situation.
